candidates.text: The external projection provisions of UN R26 do not apply to those parts of the lamp's external surface (outer lens, exposed housing rim or seal) which, with the vehicle in the laden condition and all doors, windows and access lids closed, are either at a height of more than 2 m, or below the floor line, or so located that, in their static condition as well as in operation, they cannot be contacted by a sphere 100 mm in diameter.

candidates.text: The lamp's external surface (outer lens, exposed housing rim/bezel or seal), as installed on the M1 vehicle, shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any pointed or sharp parts or any projections of such shape, dimensions, direction or hardness as to be likely to increase the risk or seriousness of bodily injury to a person hit by the external surface or brushing against it in the event of a collision.

candidates.text: The lamp's external surface, as installed on the M1 vehicle, shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any part likely to catch on pedestrians, cyclists or motor cyclists.

raw.text: The lamp's external surface, as installed on the M1 vehicle, shall not exhibit, directed outwards, any part likely to catch on pedestrians, cyclists or motor cyclists.

candidates.text: No protruding part of the lamp's external surface (outer lens edges, exposed housing rim/bezel edges) shall have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm; this does not apply to parts which protrude less than 5 mm, but the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.

raw.text: No protruding part of the lamp's external surface (outer lens edges, exposed housing rim/bezel edges) shall have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm; this does not apply to parts which protrude less than 5 mm, but the outward facing angles of such parts shall be blunted, save where such parts protrude less than 1.5 mm.

candidates.text: If a protruding part of the lamp's external surface (e.g. an exposed seal/gasket of TPE or silicone, or an edge with radius < 2.5 mm) is made of a material of hardness not exceeding 60 Shore A, it may have a radius of curvature less than 2.5 mm; the hardness shall be measured with the component as installed on the vehicle, and where a Shore A measurement is impossible, comparable measurements shall be used for evaluation.

candidates.text: Production lamps fitted to the approved vehicle type shall be so manufactured that the vehicle conforms to the type approved by meeting the requirements of paragraphs 5. and 6. of UN R26.

candidates.text: Where the lamp protrudes beyond the nominal line of the panel and is mounted on a surface other than convex, if the dimension of the lamp's projection cannot be determined by simple measurement, the projection dimension shall be determined as the maximum variation of the distance of the centre of a 100 mm diameter sphere from the nominal line of the panel when the sphere is moved over the lamp while in constant contact with it (see Annex 3, Figure 3).
